name: Control Four Bases
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, you have taken the battle of Arathi Basin to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle.  You have shown us your worth as a champion, and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy!

Because of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you.  I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in Arathi Basin.  If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the Horde our dominance!

Go, adventurer, and good fortune.
narrative.objectives: Enter Arathi Basin, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
